limitations: Every sample starts a fresh model owner; the OS file and shader caches stay unflushed.
One persistent cgroup retains charged model file pages between children; ABBA order still conditions caches, so caps alone do not explain all sample differences.
Before/after cgroup counter deltas cover the full child including cancellation, fresh recovery, owning inspections and erasure after the measured generation.
Process read bytes and per-child current peaks are sampled every 0.5 seconds and can miss increments between samples.
Unit memory.peak is cumulative across all four children; it is not a separate per-child peak.
model_bind_ms excludes device setup and lazy uploads; generation_ms covers 127 following graph steps, not an entire true hot request.
Eight-GiB correctness containment remains unchanged; these new 52-GiB public-lab runs do not authorize production private-content caching or routing.
Whole-model bitwise differences and independent quality/context/options/private-worker acceptance remain unresolved.
